tx:
To make spicy stews, players add coloured spices to a regular stew. Up to three doses of a coloured spice can be added to the regular stew to get a spicy stew of the desired strength.
Stews may be made or bought from the shops or the Grand Exchange. 
Spices must be obtained by catching Hell-Rats in the Basement of Doom in Edgeville. Hell-Rats can be caught using a cat (or hellcat) and can also be caught barehanded after completion of Evil Dave's Big Day Out without the need of a cat. Evil Dave's Big Day Out quest is therefore highly advised, because it not only makes stews more powerful but it also makes them easier to obtain. After catching a Hell-Rat with a cat, a spice shaker with up to four doses of spice of a single colour in it will be dropped on the floor. When catching a hellrat barehanded, the spices will instead be placed directly in the backpack. Players can combine same-coloured doses up to four in each shaker, just like with potions.
sc: Players can make spicy stews themselves, but they can also be obtained by completing Evil Dave court case or the Hefin Agility Course.
Players who have completed the Evil Dave's Big Day Out quest are much more likely to obtain a positive boost and have a 25% chance of getting a +6 boost when using 3 spice doses.
They could be bought in bulk from the Smuggler for 25 rusty coins each, and were used, in the same way as overworld spirit shards to make finished pouches.
